Johannes Høsflot Klæbo makes Winter Olympic history with a sixth gold medal at Milano Cortina 2026, as Norway dominates the 50km classic.
Johannes Høsflot Klæbo capped a remarkable Milano Cortina 2026 campaign on Saturday (21 February), winning the men’s 50km mass start classic to claim his sixth gold medal of the Games — becoming the first athlete in any sport to win six Olympic gold medals at the same Winter Olympics.
Klæbo stopped the clock at 2:07:07.1, pulling away late to beat compatriot Martin Løwstrøm Nyenget by 17.5 seconds, with Emil Iversen completing an all-Norwegian podium in third, 46.2 seconds back.
